title: Substrate DNA Promoting Binding of Mycobacterium tuberculosis MtrA by Facilitating Dimerization and Interpretation of Affinity by Minor Groove Width.
authors: Memon, Aadil Ahmed; Fu, Xiang; Fan, Xiao-Yong; Xu, Lingyun; Xiao, Jihua; Rahman, Mueed Ur; Yang, Xiaoqi; Yao, Yu-Feng; Deng, Zixin; Ma, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过结合序列分析、分子对接和实验验证，系统研究了结核分枝杆菌转录因子MtrA与DNA的结合亲和力、二聚化及小沟宽度对识别的影响，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，方法涉及结构建模与实验，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: In order to deepen the understanding of the role and regulation mechanisms of prokaryotic global transcription regulators in complex processes, including virulence, the associations between the affinity and binding sequences of Mycobacterium tuberculosis MtrA have been explored extensively. Analysis of MtrA 294 diversified 26 bp binding sequences revealed that the sequence similarity of fragments was not simply associated with affinity. The unique variation patterns of GC content and periodical and sequential fluctuation of affinity contribution curves were observed along the sequence in this study. Furthermore, docking analysis demonstrated that the structure of the dimer MtrA-DNA (high affinity) was generally consistent with other OmpR family members, while Arg 219 and Gly 220 of the wing domain interacted with the minor groove. The results of the binding box replacement experiment proved that box 2 was essential for binding, which implied the differential roles of the two boxes in the binding process. Furthermore, the results of the substitution of the nucleotide at the 20th and/or 21st positions indicated that the affinity was negatively associated with the value of minor groove width precisely at the 21st position. The dimerization of the unphosphorylated MtrA facilitated by a low-affinity DNA fragment was observed for the first time. However, the proportion of the dimer was associated with the affinity of substrate DNA, which further suggested that the affinity was actually one characteristic of the stability of dimers. Based on the finding of 17 inter-molecule hydrogen bonds identified in the interface of the MtrA dimer, including 8 symmetric complementary ones in the conserved alpha4-beta5-alpha5 face, we propose that hydrogen bonds should be considered just as important as salt bridges and the hydrophobic patch in the dimerization. Our comprehensive study on a large number of binding fragments with quantitative affinity values provided new insight into the molecular mechanism of dimerization, binding specificity and affinity determination of MtrA and clues for solving the puzzle of how global transcription factors regulate a large quantity of target genes.
abstract_zh: 为了加深对原核生物全局转录调控因子在包括毒力在内的复杂过程中的作用及调控机制的理解，已对结核分枝杆菌MtrA的亲和力与结合序列之间的关联进行了广泛探索。对MtrA 294个多样化的26 bp结合序列的分析揭示，片段的序列相似性并不简单地与亲和力相关。本研究观察到沿序列的GC含量独特变化模式以及亲和力贡献曲线的周期性和顺序性波动。此外，对接分析表明，二聚体MtrA-DNA（高亲和力）的结构与OmpR家族其他成员大体一致，而翼结构域的Arg 219和Gly 220与小沟相互作用。结合盒替换实验的结果证明，盒2对结合至关重要，这暗示了两个盒在结合过程中的差异作用。此外，第20位和/或第21位核苷酸替换的结果表明，亲和力与第21位小沟宽度值呈负相关。首次观察到低亲和力DNA片段促进未磷酸化MtrA的二聚化。然而，二聚体的比例与底物DNA的亲和力相关，这进一步表明亲和力实际上是二聚体稳定性的一个特征。基于在MtrA二聚体界面发现的17个分子间氢键，包括保守的alpha4-beta5-alpha5面上的8个对称互补氢键，我们提出氢键应与盐桥和疏水补丁在二聚化中同等重要。我们对大量具有定量亲和力值的结合片段的综合研究，为MtrA的二聚化、结合特异性和亲和力决定的分子机制提供了新见解，并为解决全局转录因子如何调控大量靶基因这一难题提供了线索。
